description: This file defines a function that creates French language strings for a desktop application, providing localized UI text with a fallback to English. It imports utility functions and type definitions, and returns an object containing various translations for menu items, context menus, tray options, extensions, updates, backups, and error messages.

methods.name: export function createFrenchStrings(): Strings { createFrenchStrings
methods.description: Generates and returns a set of French language strings for UI elements. It uses a fallback to English strings if not in development mode, and otherwise returns localized strings for menus, context menus, tray options, and error messages.
